entities.name: José Quiles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Quiles Brotons is a Spanish boxer. He won the silver medal in the men's featherweight event at the 2023 European Games held in Poland. He competed in the men's featherweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics held in Tokyo, Japan and the men's featherweight event at the 2024 Summer Olympics held in Paris, France.
